combo_label: Breakfast × Puppets & Punch and Judy × Roald Dahl

entries.clue: Live dog in a frilled collar once part of the Punch show, and a jug shaped as a man
Cocoa sweet, churned by waterfall, that runs as a river through the factory
Robbed from the comb of a hive, golden and slow to leave the spoon
Great glass lift that bursts through a roof and climbs into orbit
Stiff shaft worked from beneath to move a puppet's arm or turn its head
What the Scots boil into porridge, flattened into flakes by a roller
Green frog puppet who fronts a famous TV variety show and sings Bein' Green
Beaten, set in a hot pan and folded in half over ham or grated cheese
Bedside noise set the night before, silenced with a slap at seven
Disgusting; the adjective Dahl hung on his 1982 book of twisted verses
